name: Re-entry Route Documentation
description: During the initial access phase, documenting identified entry vectors — successful techniques, bypass methods that worked, timing windows, and staff patterns — builds an operational playbook for re-entry without requiring a full recon cycle. Body-worn camera footage reviewed after the engagement reveals details not captured in field notes, and identified blind spots noted during transit become the basis for a re-entry route that avoids improved defenses.

blue.det: Difficult to detect during authorized access — operator is documenting; post-engagement discovery of detailed entry route notes on seized device.
blue.cm: Remediate all identified vulnerabilities immediately after engagement; re-test all entry points; physical security review after each red team engagement; access control audit post-engagement.
